_comment: Plugins this workspace expects, but deliberately does NOT vendor.
Both are AGPL-3.0. Committing their built main.js into a public MIT-licensed
template would redistribute copyleft binaries under an incompatible license.
They are two clicks each from Obsidian's own plugin browser, so the cost of
not vendoring them is small and the cost of vendoring them is a license
community-plugins.json still lists them, so the enable-list travels with the
clone. `./workspace obsidian-setup` reports which are missing.
Templater is the exception that proves the rule: its directory is ignored,
but data.json.example and SETUP.md inside it are not, because without them
Templater arrives unconfigured and every template throws.
